title: Bật Automated Sync kèm Prune và Self-Heal cho ArgoCD
code:
syncPolicy:
  automated:
    prune: true
    selfHeal: true
  syncOptions:
    - CreateNamespace=true

title: Gắn Sync Wave -1 cho Job chạy trước Deployment
code:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: db-migrate
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "-1"
